simd_variants.verified-sse2-16: one 16-byte vector loop and byte tail
simd_variants.verified-sse2-64: 64-byte superloop, 16-byte cleanup loop and byte tail
simd_variants.verified-avx2-128: 128-byte superloop with four independent reduction accumulators, 32-byte cleanup; copy uses endpoint tail coverage, reductions retain byte tails
simd_variants.verified-avx512-256: 256-byte superloop with four independent reduction accumulators, 64-byte cleanup; copy uses endpoint tail coverage, reductions retain byte tails
simd_variants.verified-avx2-copy-byte-tail: simultaneous original 128-byte copy superloop with interleaved loads/stores and byte tail
simd_variants.verified-avx512-copy-byte-tail: simultaneous original 256-byte copy superloop with interleaved loads/stores and byte tail
simd_variants.verified-avx2-bounded-tail: 128-byte superloop; short inputs bypass wide initialization; 16-byte cleanup and nonoverlapping 8/4/2/1-byte reduction tail
simd_variants.verified-avx512-bounded-tail: 256-byte superloop; short inputs bypass wide initialization; 16-byte cleanup and nonoverlapping 8/4/2/1-byte reduction tail
simd_variants.verified-avx2-copy-endpoints-fast: 128-byte copy superloop; endpoint tail with direct one-byte dispatch
simd_variants.verified-avx512-copy-endpoints-fast: 256-byte copy superloop; endpoint tail with direct one-byte dispatch
simd_variants.verified-avx2-bounded-one: separate 128-byte reduction candidate; complete range admission followed by direct one-byte entry, otherwise the bounded reduction
simd_variants.verified-avx512-bounded-one: separate 256-byte reduction candidate; complete range admission followed by direct one-byte entry, otherwise the bounded reduction

data: deterministic xorshift64* bytes; all-zero scan input with untimed nonzero controls
primary_statistic: median ns/call, with all 21 samples retained
correctness: independent scalar recurrence, nonzero scan controls, exact checksum and copy-byte comparisons for every batch
direct_span_baseline: original checked packed-u32 ABI; wrapping-u64 accumulation retained and final return narrowed. All benchmark counts and byte sums fit u32, so valid-input outputs agree. Invalid-input ABI behaviors are distinct.
order: one deterministic shuffle of all cases with seed 20261119
reruns: no selected-cell reruns or discarded samples
machine_sharing: affinity is not exclusive CPU ownership
runtime_identity: record glibc binary hash/version and actual memcpy IFUNC offset using a baseline-ISA helper under the same affinity and environment
